seoDescription: TOTAL MEDIA is a full-service event production and technical solutions company operating across Japan. Learn about our approach and values.
title: A Technical Standard Built Over Years, Not Assumed on Day One
description: TOTAL MEDIA was built around a simple observation: most event failures happen at the coordination seams between vendors, not within any single discipline.
storyTitle: From equipment rental to full production, because clients kept asking for both.
storyParagraph1: TOTAL MEDIA started as a technical equipment provider and grew into a full-service production company because our clients kept asking for the same thing: someone to own the whole event, not just the gear. Today, equipment rental is one part of a broader practice that includes event planning, technical direction, and on-site management.
storyParagraph2: We operate nationwide across Japan, serving international companies, Japanese enterprises, government bodies, universities, and luxury brands — organizations that need production values matching the seriousness of what they're announcing, launching, or presenting.

values.title: Precision Over Improvisation
values.description: Every technical plan is rehearsed before it's live. We treat contingency planning as part of the design, not a reaction to something going wrong.

values.title: One Accountable Team
values.description: We'd rather say no to a job than hand you a coordination burden across five vendors. If we take it on, we own it end to end.

values.title: Built for International Clients
values.description: Bilingual project management isn't a premium add-on — it's how every international engagement is staffed from day one.

values.title: Quiet, Disciplined Crews
values.description: The best technical production is the kind your audience never notices. Our crews are trained to be invisible until they're needed.

ctaTitle: Want to Talk Through Your Event?
ctaDescription: Tell us what you're planning — we'll respond with next steps within 1–2 business days.
